name: Another Heaven: Memory of those Days
original_name: アナザヘヴン〜memory of those days〜
source: Another Heaven: Memory of those Days (アナザヘヴン〜memory of those days〜) is a Horror/Visual Novel video game published by Omega Micott released on 2000 for the WonderSwan Color.
translation: Another Heaven: Memory of those Days（ナザヘヴン〜回忆那些日子〜）是由Omega Micott于2000年为WonderSwan Color发行的恐怖/视觉小说视频游戏。
